selection_basis: Pinned dataset metadata only; no old outcomes. Ten distinct domains, difficulty quotas3easy/5medium/2hard and capability quotas2forms/3filters/3extraction-comparison/2interactive. Rank SHA256(seed|capability|level|task_id) with frozen capability priority and uniqueness constraints.
live_policy: No outcome-based substitutions. Serial A five, concurrent all ten, serial B five, with A/B split ranked by SHA256(seed|order|task_id). Shared signed-in Chrome cookies; no claim of identical clean browser state or causal noninferiority.
